step1_analysis.description: A dual differential pair sharing cross-coupled output nodes. It functions as a current-steering DAC segment or an analog multiplexer used for dynamic element matching and mismatch shaping.

paper_reference.title: A 2-GS/s 3-bit -Modulated DAC With Tunable Bandpass Mismatch Shaping

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the cell

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 1mA tail currents and 1.8V supply in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_parasitic). R_load=500, C~20fF -> ~15 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the RC time constant of the load resistor and transistor parasitic capacitances.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from input to differential output

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = g_m * R_load. g_m ~ 4.3mS, R_load = 500 -> 2.15 V/V = 6.6 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using typical SKY130 NMOS g_m at 0.5mA bias current.

t_rise.description: Rise time of the output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant at the output nodes.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC bandwidth, DC gain, and transient rise/fall times of the DAC cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for DAC cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_n = 10u
.param L_n = 0.15u
.param R_load = 500
.param I_tail = 1m

VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8

R1 VDD OUT1 {R_load}
R2 VDD OUT2 {R_load}

I1 N0 0 {I_tail}
I2 N1 0 {I_tail}

M1 OUT2 IN2 N1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M2 OUT1 IN2X N1 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M3 OUT1 IN1 N0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M4 OUT2 IN1X N0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}

VIN1 IN1 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.7 1.1 100p 50p 50p 400p 1n)
VIN1X IN1X 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PULSE(1.1 0.7 100p 50p 50p 400p 1n)
VIN2 IN2 0 DC 0.9 AC 0 PULSE(1.1 0.7 100p 50p 50p 400p 1n)
VIN2X IN2X 0 DC 0.9 AC 0 PULSE(0.7 1.1 100p 50p 50p 400p 1n)

E1 diff_out 0 OUT1 OUT2 1.0

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(diff_out)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 2n
  meas tran v_max max v(OUT1)
  meas tran v_min min v(OUT1)
  * Measure rise and fall times between 1.1V and 1.5V to ensure crossing
  meas tran t_fall trig v(OUT1) val=1.5 fall=1 targ v(OUT1) val=1.1 fall=1
  meas tran t_rise trig v(OUT1) val=1.1 rise=1 targ v(OUT1) val=1.5 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
